name: kras_g12d_pmhc_01
description: De novo miniprotein, 68 aa, 0 Cys. Declared epitope: HLA-A*11:01-restricted KRAS G12D decamer VVVGADGVGK, peptide residues G4, A5, D6, G7, V8, G9 - the solvent-exposed central bulge. Interface buries 196 A^2 of peptide surface (17% of 1128 A^2 total buried on the target). Sequence identity by local alignment: 6% to beta2-microglobulin, 10% to HLA-A*11:01 alpha1-alpha2. Boltz-2 co-fold against the alpha1-alpha2 / beta2m / peptide trimer: design-to-target ipSAE 0.345, ipTM 0.649, minimum interaction PAE 3.8 A. Monomer refold, Chai-1 single-sequence, target absent: pLDDT 0.905. ProteinMPNN peptide-probability test, change in log-odds P(Asp6)/P(Gly6) relative to the binder-free control: -0.53 (glycine control 0.92). Three-target counter-screen (Chai-1, MSA-backed, identical settings across analytes): removing the peptide costs 62% of binder-to-MHC interface ipTM (0.827 G12D -> 0.317 apo), the strongest peptide dependence measured in this set. G12D vs wild-type binder-peptide ipTM 0.111 vs 0.106 - no mutation discrimination. Cross-panel against ten HLA-A*11:01 ligands: rejects two unrelated EBV epitopes (8-18% of on-target), the 9-mer register (12%) and KRAS G12R (12%); does not resolve G12A/G12C/G12V/G12S (67-85%). GFN2-xTB ddE -1.10 kcal/mol on a 5 A truncation with ALPB solvation, within method uncertainty and reported as a tie-breaker. 6.63 ns complex MD: binder Ca RMSD plateaus at 1.82 +/- 0.17 A and peptide contacts hold at 52.9 +/- 10.9 with no decay.
